title: Compact never makes text smaller than normal body text
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Know the application's minimum body text size.
custom_steps:
1. Set Compact density in each display.
  2. Measure/compare the row and card text size.
  3. Confirm it is not below the minimum body text size.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Compact density never shrinks text below the application's minimum body text size.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10049 — Story 6 Density. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S6-R4 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R4: “Compact density must not reduce text below the application’s minimum body text size.”
